To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present FUSE: a front-end user framework for operating system abstraction of hardware accelerators.
we present a framework for hardware accelerator abstraction in an FPGA-based embedded platform, and that we achieve performance speed ups of 6.4 to 37 times over the CPU alone.

1) FUSE provides an abstraction layer that allows SW designers to use the same application code regardless of the hardware platform, 2) FUSE provides OS support to integrate HW accelerators, 3) FUSE provides a performance improvement of 6.4x to 37x for the three applications, and 4) FUSE can be easily extended for use with any reconfigurable hardware platform and OS.

providing the SW designer with the flexibility of reconfiguration while maintaining OS support for the application.
how to provide a seamless integration of HW accelerators in the reconfigurability paradigm.
